moves.name: Dancing Flames Flare Blitz
moves.description:
Activation Condition: When a circle is applied to the allied field of play.
Deactivation Condition: Cannot be deactivated.

Removes the frozen condition from the user. Never misses. Lowers the target’s Defense by 1 stat rank. Has a chance (10%) of leaving the target burned. The power and chance of applying additional effects of this move are not lowered even if there are multiple targets.

moves.name: Unova Passion
moves.description: Increases the Physical Moves ↑ Next effect of all allied sync pairs by 1 rank. Applies Unova Circle (Physical) to the allied field of play. Unova Circle (Physical) grants all of the following effects: Powers up the physical attack moves and physical sync moves of all allied sync pairs by 10%. Reduces physical attack move and physical sync move damage taken by all allied sync pairs by 5%. The more sync pairs with the Unova theme that are on the allied field of play, the higher these percentages are. (Each additional sync pair powers up moves and sync moves by 10% and reduces damage by 3%. The maximum power-up is 40%, and the maximum damage reduction is 14%.)

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: Applies the Damage Guard Next effect to the user.

moves.name: Keep It Burning!
moves.description: Applies the Supereffective ↑ Next effect to the user. Applies the Free Move Next effect to the user. Increases the user’s Sync Move ↑ Next effect by 4 ranks.

passives.name: Burning Up!

subPassives.name: Ally Sets Circle: Physical Boost ↑2 9

passives.name: The Perfect Temperature
passives.description: Grants all of the following effects the first time the user uses Unova Passion each battle: Raises the user’s Attack by 4 stat ranks. Raises the user’s critical-hit rate by 3 stat ranks. Applies the Supereffective ↑ Next effect to the user.

passives.name: Circle: Team All Stats ↓ Immunity
passives.description: Stats cannot be lowered for all allied sync pairs when a circle applies to the allied field of play.
